messages:
devin: getting a burst of remote_write timeouts to our ingest cluster in us-west-2, dashboards show queue_length skyrocketing, prom_remote_write_errors firing :warning:
julie_sre: saw that — looks like a sudden cardinality jump too, many new series from sidecar pods
maria_ops: any recent relabel or prometheus config changes? I didn't push anything last night
devin: nope, nothing from our CI. alert history shows spike at 12:03 UTC, then retry churn
tim_oncall: logs from prometheus-sidecar-0: `level=error msg="remote_write failed" err="timeout writing to endpoint"` repeated a lot. Pasting snippet:
```
2026-03-10T12:03:05Z level=error component=remote_write err="write tcp 10.3.2.5:4242->10.8.0.12:9090: write: connection reset by peer"
2026-03-10T12:03:11Z level=warn component=queue manager="backoff" dur=5s
```
julie_sre: can you `kubectl get pods -n monitoring -l app=prometheus-sidecar -o wide` and check restart counts? might be a misbehaving exporter or relabel causing fanout
devin: pods look fine, restarts=0. But `promtool check config` flagged a relabel rule with a greedy regex we added for aws_tags last week
maria_ops: which rule? posting excerpt:
```
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app, __meta_kubernetes_service_label_env]
  regex: (.+);(.+);(.*)
  target_label: extra_tag
```
julie_sre: that regex can explode when combined with pod labels that contain commas; it's producing many unique `extra_tag` values => cardinality spike. We should drop that relabel and roll back
tim_oncall: rolling a quick patch to monitoring config now. Also temporarily increase remote_write timeout to 30s and bump queue_capacity on sidecars to absorb backlog `--remote-write.timeout=30s --remote-write.queue-capacity=50000`
devin: thanks. I'm also enabling a relabel reject to drop highly cardinal metrics as a safety net: `relabel_action: drop` for `job=sidecar` where label `extra_tag` matches regex `.*,.*,.*`
maria_ops: after patch, queue_length is down and errors subsided. We'll keep extra observability panels for series churn rate and new-series-per-minute
julie_sre: follow-up: open a PR to tighten relabeling and add unit test for label shapes. Also file an eval to see whether autoscaling for sidecars needs higher headroom in us-west-2 during batch jobs
cortex_ingest_bot: incident note created: INC-2026-032-17 — added tags: remote_write, cardinality, us-west-2
devin: closing loop — thanks all. Will monitor for 2 hours and revert timeout change if stable :thumbsup:
